The '''Alliance Combat Patrol Transport''',<ref name="Web">{{TORweb|url=info/news/news-article/20170502-1|text=May the 4th Hits the Cartel Market}}</ref> also known as the '''AC-PT Walker'''<ref name="SWTOR" /> was a two-legged combat [[Walker/Legends|walker]] used by the [[Eternal Alliance]].

{{Military-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The AC-PT Walker was added to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' with patch 5.2.1. It was available though a promotional event.
